public.text: The document mentions sovereign models and openness but does not provide guidance on how countries should decide between building their own AI capabilities, relying on commercial offerings, or using open-weight models. This decision has significant implications for cost, sovereignty, and sustainability.
public.suggestedRevision: Add guidance on the AI procurement landscape, including: criteria for evaluating commercial AI offerings (performance, cost, data sovereignty, security); consideration of open-weight and open-source models as alternatives to proprietary models; procurement clauses that protect national data assets and ensure portability; and the conditions under which sovereign AI infrastructure (national or regional) may be worth the investment.
